distractors.text_hint: finished the repair on the IM3 last night
signed off the inspection on the WHB on Tuesday
noticed the Injection Moulding Line 1 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down

can't get to the site water until production gives us a window

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me? Right, Monday the 29th. Let's get through this before Teams decides otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid. I've spent longer looking at a bus than looking at production this morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still less painful than the football last night.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Oh, don't start. Some of us were trying to forget that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, football analysis closed. Anything already finished before we get into the live stuff?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, finished the repair on the IM3 last night. That's completed, not something carrying over into today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, that's off the live list then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the WHB on Tuesday. That one's already done as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the Injection Moulding Line 1 was running a bit warm, but it settled down. Nothing new coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I heard a slight rattle from the GT2 bearing. Nothing to action yet, just saying what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, observations only. Neither of those is a fresh job from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I still can't get to the site water until production gives us a window. That's blocked, not something I can crack on with today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window agreed. That hasn't changed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Leaving that blocked, no new commitment against it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: We need someone to do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two. That's holding production up so it needs doing first. Anyone able to take it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, I can't take that sign-off. Don't put it against me just because I've given the electrical update.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, understood. Nobody's taken it, then. It stays unowned; mentioning it isn't a sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And half two is still the required time, yeah. The production hold hasn't gone away just because we haven't got a name.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll schedule downtime for the 11kV board with production after lunch. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You're doing the scheduling after lunch, not saying the board's coming off after lunch?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll agree the downtime with production after lunch. I'm not announcing an outage time here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers, Olu. Scheduling with production is yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: For me, I'll go to Harbour Road Warehouse to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 chiller on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On the 3rd, right? Not a collection today?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yes. That one's safety critical, straight away—it's not a routine pickup to leave sitting about. The collection date is still the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got it, Tomasz. Safety-critical collection, on the 3rd. Those two bits are clear.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—monthly test, not the separate panel function test?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, just the monthly fire alarm test. I'll do that after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. Separate entries, definitely.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sarah, can you run a function test on the fire alarm panel next week? That's the other one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the function test on the fire alarm panel next week.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. I only asked because those two descriptions keep sounding like the same thing when the audio drops.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, fair question. Monthly test after lunch; panel function test next week. Not doubling up the owners.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 2 today at 2pm. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Two o'clock, did you say? You went a bit robotic at the end there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Today at 2pm, yeah. I'll take the guarding check, and it's urgent, not a routine look whenever.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Got you, Hannah. That's clearly yours.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The other gap is we need someone to swap the filter on the compressor one by end of day. Anyone taking that?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me. Just to be clear, being on the stores call isn't me volunteering to fit it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't take that one either.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right. Nobody on the filter swap, then. Still needed by end of day, still unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, don't hide that with a vague 'maintenance' against it. We haven't agreed an owner.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Jamie, can you send the shift handover report round, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round. Whenever I get a chance, understood.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's just circulating the report, isn't it? Not another report we're all suddenly writing?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just sending it round. No extra bit of work for everyone tucked in there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Lovely. Yes, I'll take sending it. Nice to have one that doesn't involve chasing a delivery wagon.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sarah, can you grease and check the bearings on the booster pump? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll grease and check the bearings on the booster pump. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's separate from the rattle you mentioned earlier, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, different thing. The GT2 bearing rattle is observation only, nothing to action yet. I'm accepting the booster pump job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, urgent bits haven't changed: Boiler Safety Relief Valve sign-off at half two, holding production up, needs doing first, but no owner. Guarding check today at 2pm is urgent and has an owner.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I've got the Injection Moulding Line 2 guarding check. No ambiguity on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And Olu, the 11kV board scheduling after lunch—not an emergency, but not to drift.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, mine. I'll schedule it with production after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just so the water doesn't get swept into that conversation, the site water is still blocked by the production window. No change from me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, agreed. We're not treating that as released work.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And the IM3 repair is finished. I know we've gone round a few things twice, but that one really is off the list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep. Longer-dated ones: Sarah has the fire alarm panel function test next week, and I've got Harbour Road Warehouse for the line 3 chiller parts on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, next week for my panel function test. Separate from Callum's monthly test after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And we're ending with two explicit gaps: nobody for the Boiler Safety Relief Valve sign-off at half two, nobody for the compressor one filter swap by end of day. Neither is magically covered.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right. More honest than the commentary on that match, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You nearly made it to the end without mentioning it again. Cheers, everyone, that's us.
